budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip Prague average star-rating table; result crawled 3 weeks before 2026-07-31; prices before taxes and fees
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Prague? Hotel Prices for Prague, Czech Republic | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.evidenceText: The average prices by star rating for hotels in Prague are: 5-Star Hotels $147, 4-Star $101, 3-Star $95, 2-Star $84, 1-Star Hotels $76. Prices are in US Dollars before taxes and fees.
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Prague Czechia 1-star hotel average nightly price
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.reason: Accepted as an exact Prague city-level 1-star price statistic with USD currency and a dated source window. Occupancy is source-default-room; the source separately reports $76 for one person sharing a room, so the row carries a definitional warning and is not an observed two-adult value.
